facts.text: Sensor fusion combines measurements from several different sensors into one picture of the surroundings that is more reliable than any single sensor could provide.
facts.quote: Sensor fusion is the combining of measurements from several different sensors into one picture of the surroundings that is more reliable than any single sensor could give.

facts.text: Fusion software aligns sensor outputs in space and time and determines which objects are real, where they are, and the confidence in those determinations.
facts.quote: Fusion software aligns their outputs in space and time and decides which objects are real, where they are and how confident to be.

facts.text: Sensor fusion can merge raw data before detection or merge each sensor's object list after detection; both approaches need accurate calibration and a shared clock.
facts.quote: Fusion can merge raw data before detection or merge each sensor's object list afterwards; either way it needs accurate calibration and a shared clock.

facts.text: Multi-technology systems are the norm in mining collision avoidance.
facts.quote: multi-technology systems are the norm in mining collision avoidance [Chapter 1]

facts.text: Adding a sensor turns validation into a fusion problem: the safety argument must cover common-cause degradation, such as one dust cloud blinding camera and lidar together, and disagreement between sensor modalities.
facts.quote: adding a sensor turns validation into a fusion problem: the safety argument must cover common-cause degradation, where one dust cloud blinds camera and lidar together, and disagreement between modalities [Chapter 1]

facts.text: A synthetic scene must give all sensors mutually consistent geometry and timing.
facts.quote: A synthetic scene must give all sensors mutually consistent geometry and timing

facts.text: Validating each sensor separately does not prove that the fused stack is correct; cross-sensor consistency is a blind spot in single-sensor validation.
facts.quote: the booklet lists cross-sensor consistency as a blind spot that single-sensor validation does not cover [Chapter 6]

facts.text: The reference system used for ground truth should combine complementary sensors and include an explicit "truth unavailable" state when all sensors degrade.
facts.quote: The reference system used for ground truth should itself combine complementary sensors, with an explicit "truth unavailable" state when all degrade [Chapter 7].

facts.text: One construction study fused camera and lidar to remove dust from point clouds and scored 65.58% in a far, dense dust case, compared with 94.85% to 96.73% elsewhere.
facts.quote: One construction study fused camera and lidar to remove dust from point clouds and scored 65.58% in a far, dense dust case against 94.85% to 96.73% elsewhere [Chapter 13].

facts.text: Sensor fusion enables a system to brake in dust while distinguishing a person from a berm, but multiplies the combinations that must be tested.
facts.quote: Fusion is how a system can brake in dust and still tell a person from a berm, but it multiplies the combinations to be tested
